title: pyrus aucuparia var. typica
intro: Pyrus aucuparia var. typica, commonly known as the Rowan or Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Northern Europe. It is valued for its bright red berries and its ability to ward off evil spirits in Celtic mythology. The Rowan plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the Rowan plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
